description: Espressif ESP32-WROOM-32E — dual-core Xtensa LX6 MCU module (240 MHz), 4MB flash, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi + Bluetooth 4.2/5.0. The default go-to ESP32 module for most designs. 18×25.5mm PCB antenna.
name: esp32-wroom-32e-n4
watch_out_for: 3.3V logic only — all GPIOs are NOT 5V tolerant. 500mA peak current; a 500mA LDO minimum. EN pin needs RC delay (10kΩ + 1µF) for reliable boot. Strapping pins: GPIO0/2/5/12/15 affect boot mode.
